authority_note: This immutable test fixture is not an editable pilot-record authority. The structured JSON contract remains the sole editable source after migration.

records.title: Bounded attitude experiment use
records.statement: The B0 system shall support a configured, repeatable bounded attitude experiment for engineering review without claiming full-flight capability.
records.rationale: This is a source-format trial of a user-need record. It is not a formal B0 requirement and is not part of coverage accounting.

applicability.scope: current B0 bounded attitude experiments only; excludes hardware, flight, and unactivated extensions

records.acceptance_condition: planned inspection confirms the declared experiment boundary and exclusions are present

records.title: Runtime truth isolation
records.statement: After explicit reset initialization, the estimator and controller shall not receive live truth as a runtime input; truth is limited to plant, sensor, and evaluation responsibilities.
records.rationale: This trial represents an interface constraint and a child relationship without treating existing component behavior as the sole source of the obligation.

applicability.scope: current B0 after explicit reset initialization

records.acceptance_condition: planned inspection verifies declared runtime inputs exclude live truth and evaluation remains independent

records.title: Frozen acceptance-field reference
records.statement: Any assessment of the signed three-axis step scenario shall cite the approved G0 v2 configuration fields for its event window and metrics instead of copying numerical thresholds into a second requirement source.
records.rationale: This trial represents a performance/acceptance reference while preserving the JSON contract as the sole parameter source and avoiding a false performance result.

applicability.scope: current B0 signed three-axis step assessment; configuration evidence remains proposed_not_executed

records.acceptance_condition: planned inspection verifies each assessment points to a versioned JSON field and does not duplicate a numeric threshold

records.title: Preserved legacy control applicability
records.statement: For current B0, the applicability record shall preserve CTL-REQ-001 and CTL-REQ-002 unchanged and record their approved not-applicable status without claiming that either legacy performance threshold is satisfied.
records.rationale: This trial represents a non-applicable legacy relationship. The legacy identifiers remain references only and are never candidate identifiers for reuse.

applicability.scope: current B0 only; CTL-REQ-001 and CTL-REQ-002 remain preserved for their historical scopes under the approved disposition

records.acceptance_condition: planned inspection verifies both legacy identifiers, their decision locator, and the absence of a satisfaction claim

records.title: Planned controller interface boundary
records.statement: The planned G2 controller shall consume the declared command, state estimate, and paired actuator feedback; it shall expose requested torque, limited target, and saturation status under the approved reset and step contract.
records.rationale: This is a planned component candidate used to test truthful planned/not-run status. It does not claim a G2 implementation or closed-loop evidence.

applicability.scope: planned G2 controller only; not an implemented or accepted component

records.acceptance_condition: planned G2 verification defines inputs, reset and step behavior, an independent oracle, and execution evidence before any pass claim
